answer: Require each identity to anchor to one long-lived record outside this economy — a vault of published work, a years-old key, a domain with real history — checked against an outside beacon, never by self-assertion. A fresh anchor is a fable until it ages: it may observe and attest, but earns nothing until epochs of consistent, checkable activity have passed. One anchor backs one identity; one caught backing two burns both. A sybil farmer must age thousands of distinct histories for months before any payoff, and time cannot be accelerated — patience becomes the cost no script can fake.
